cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet: - povinná účast na cvičeních (80 %, tj. 2 absence) - povinné úspěšné splnění zápočtového testu z cvičení (kritérium 60 %). Zkouška: - písemná část zkoušky - 10 testových otázek zahrnujících obsah přednášek a cvičení předmětu (kritérium 70 %), ústní část - 1 otázka = ověření znalostí na 1 zadaném úkolu konzervačního principu nebo úchovy (jakostních parametrů) potravinářských surovin živočišného původu. Pozn. Součástí cvičení je účast (Den s mlékem na MENDELU) na mezinárodní konferenci Ingrovy dny pořádané pracovištěm Ústavu technologie potravin AF MENDELU v rozsahu 4 hodin přednášky a cvičení a splnění úkolu zadaného vyučujícím.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Subject for students programme Horticulture of the Faculty of Horticulture. It informs them about animal products questions, legislation and problems with processing and quality parameters.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.General theses on production, ensuring health safety, legislation and quality assessment of foods of animal origin. (allowance 2/2) a.Introduction to the issue, animal production of food raw materials and foods. Quality, food safety and price. Consumer behavior.b.Legislation, food and veterinary state authority of food of animal origin. Food safety, HACCP, GMP, GHP.2.Slaughter animals and slaughter products, requirements, intravital and postmortem effects. (allowance 2/2) a.Welfare, monetization of carcass, breeds.b.Slaughterhouse. Value and chemical composition of meat.c.Requirements, intravital and postmortem effects.3.Meat production and processing. (allowance 6/6) a.Meat, use, labeling and storage.b.Technology of meat processing and production groups of meat products according to the groups specified in the decree.c.Quality assessment, defects of meat products.4.Dairy and dairy industry. (allowance 6/6) a.Milk, use, labeling and storage.b.Technology of milk processing and production of dairy product groups according to the groups specified in the decree.c.Quality assessment, defects of dairy products.5.Slaughter processing of poultry and quality classification. (allowance 2/2)6.Concept and requirements of PPP for the environment. (allowance 4/4) a.Lecture by a practicing expert on a selected topic.b.Documentation.c.Inspections.7.Other animal products of minor range. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Credit: - mandatory participation in seminars (80%, i.e. 2 absences) - mandatory successful completion of the credit test from the seminar (criterion 60%). Exam: - written part of the exam - 10 test questions covering the content of lectures and seminars of the course (criterion 70%), oral part - 1 question = verification of knowledge on 1 assigned task of the conservation principle or storage (quality parameters) of food raw materials. Note: The seminar includes participation (Milk Day at MENDELU) in the international conference Ingr's Days organized by the Department of Food Technology, Faculty of AgriSciences, MENDELU, instead of 4 hours of lecture and seminar and completion of the task assigned by the teacher.
